summary: You have a 4.8 rating from 386 reviews and a broad treatment menu, but dead menus, a stuck promo and no physician named hold back a premium brand.

findings.problem: The menu parents Treatments, Anti-Aging and Body Treatments link to #, and CO2 Laser goes to different pages on desktop and mobile.
findings.cost: A client choosing a treatment hits dead menus and mixed pages.
findings.fix: Working menus with one page per treatment.

findings.problem: The Gift Card Bonus Event banner reads Aug 25 to Sept 7 with no year, and its countdown shows all zeros.
findings.fix: A dated, working offer or none.

findings.problem: All booking buttons go to /contact. No booking form appears and there is no WhatsApp, only SMS and WeChat.
findings.cost: Clients who want to book now have extra steps.
findings.fix: A short booking form and a messaging option.

findings.problem: No before and after images show, no physician is named although the page says to choose a med spa overseen by a medical doctor, and the copy says There's no other clinic like this.
findings.cost: Clients want proof, and unsupported claims weaken trust.
findings.fix: Captioned results, a named medical director and sourced claims.

redesign: A booking form and working menus on every page.
Captioned results, a named medical director and a dated offers section.
